findings.F-K1: rtl/qwen_sys/host_20261013/qkd_host_program_loader_target.sv target_words(10)=76 (32+43+1) but qkd_static_kv_boot_dispatch DIECAP=1 (kvs_ctl u_boot) requires 32+43+2=77: the HOST refuses the die-cfg image; same on origin/main and claude/qlb-kv-gsrc-1018. Fix: 77 (or derive from DIECAP); diagnostic copy run/qkd_host_program_loader_target_t10w77.sv
findings.F-K2: after target 10 the HOST loader keeps program_ready high (host_rst_n is not the functional reset); a functional re-reset clears the dispatcher's ready_q, so at release it sees a new rising boot_image_ready of target 10 with next_word 0 -> fault code 7. Works if the HOST BEGINs the next image before releasing the functional resets (default bench order). RTL fix option: dispatcher arms ready_q=1 out of reset (ignore a ready already high at release), or the HOST reset role drops boot_image_ready while die_rst_n is low.
findings.F-K3: kvs14c leaves qkd_kv_die_cfg rst_dly / ectl_b_cfg / ectl_c_cfg unconnected (the 42 qkd_rst_region dly pins are die constants; die ECTL3 takes ectl_a only): the target-10 reset words have no consumer (KVJ-F law says HOST-loaded); and no tool emits target 10 from a die plan (kv_static_programme.py takes die_cfg_words but nothing supplies them)
findings.F-K4: the HOST image digest (rotl7 ^ word ^ addr) cancels words repeated with an address period of 64 an even number of times and all address terms of a 1024-word image: targets 6..9 digest = seed ^ target (32 identical PC images per stack), the same as an all-zero image; a transfer that zeroes or permutes those images passes auth
